lessons.title: Question 1
lessons.interactiveContent:
What are margins?

The space outside an element's border which defines how far it is from another elementThe distance between an element's content and its borderThe distance between the text of an element and the text of another element

The space outside an element's border which defines how far it is from another element.
lessons.hardModeContent:
A card has a border and needs more distance from the cards next to it. Which space should you change?

The space outside the card's borderThe space between the card's content and its borderThe thickness of the card's border

The space outside the card's border.

lessons.title: Question 2
lessons.interactiveContent:
What are paddings?

The space between the content and the border of an elementThe space around an element, outside of any bordersThe border of an element

The space between the content and the border of an element.
lessons.hardModeContent:
A button's text looks too close to its border. Which space should you increase?

The space between the button's content and its borderThe space outside the button's borderThe button's border itself

The space between the button's content and its border.

lessons.title: Question 4
lessons.interactiveContent:
What's the padding-top property for?

It adds space at the top of an element's contentIt adds space at the bottom of an element's contentIt adds space at the top and bottom of an element's content

It adds space at the top of an element's content.
lessons.hardModeContent:
A paragraph needs extra space only above its content, inside the border. Which statement describes padding-top?

It adds space at the top of an element's contentIt adds space above an element's borderIt adds space at every side of an element's content

It adds space at the top of an element's content.

lessons.title: Example 7
lessons.interactiveContent:
Set both left and right margins to 90px.

Make sure to pick 90px, followed by 90px.
lessons.hardModeContent:
Move only the general paragraph 90px away from nearby elements on both sides.

Make sure to pick .general, followed by margin-left, 90px, margin-right, and finally 90px.

lessons.title: Example 8
lessons.interactiveContent:
Set the side margins to 50px the top margin to 30px, and the bottom margin to 20px.

Make sure to pick 50px followed by 50px and then 30px, 20px.
lessons.hardModeContent:
Set the heading's margins so the sides are 50px, the top is 30px, and the bottom is 20px.

Make sure to pick 50px, followed by 50px, 30px, margin-bottom, and finally 20px.

lessons.title: Question: Box model
lessons.interactiveContent:
How do we set the values for the padding shorthand?

ClockwiseCounterclockwiseThe order doesn't matter

Make sure to pick Clockwise.
lessons.hardModeContent:
You write padding: 5px 10px 15px 20px;. What is the right padding?

10px20px15px

Make sure to pick 10px.

lessons.title: Example: Padding right and left
lessons.interactiveContent:
Set the top and bottom padding to 20px and the left and right paddings to 30px.

Make sure to pick 20px followed by 30px and then 20px, 30px.
lessons.hardModeContent:
Use padding shorthand so the image has 20px on top and bottom, and 30px on the left and right.

Make sure to pick padding, followed by 20px, 30px, 20px, and finally 30px.

lessons.title: Question: Padding top
lessons.interactiveContent:
What's the value for the top padding of the p element?

20px40px50px

Make sure to pick 20px.
lessons.hardModeContent:
The paragraph uses padding: 20px 15px 40px 15px. Which sides have matching padding?

Top and bottom have different padding, while left and right are both 15px.Top and bottom are both 20px.Left and right are both 40px.The 50px margin sets the right padding.

Top and bottom have different padding, while left and right are both 15px.

lessons.title: Question: Zero
lessons.interactiveContent:
What happens when we set a margin to 0 with the shorthand and leave out px?

Nothing, px is optional in that caseThe code doesn't workThe content disappears

Nothing, px is optional in that case.
lessons.hardModeContent:
You change margin: 0 10px 0 10px; to margin: 0 10 0 10;. Why is the new value invalid?

The 10 values need units, but the zero values do notEvery value, including zero, needs pxThe zero values need units, but the 10 values do not

The 10 values need units, but the zero values do not.

lessons.title: Example: Padding right and left
lessons.interactiveContent:
Set the left and right padding to 60px.

Make sure to pick padding followed by 0 and then 60px, 0, 60px.
lessons.hardModeContent:
Use one shorthand declaration so the h3 has 60px padding on the left and right, and no padding on top or bottom.

Make sure to pick padding, followed by 0, 60px, 0, and finally 60px.

lessons.title: Question: Margins right
lessons.interactiveContent:
What's the last value when using the margin shorthand?

The left sideThe right sideThe bottom

The left side.
lessons.hardModeContent:
A rule uses margin: 5px 10px 15px 20px. Which margin value applies to the left side?

20px5px10px15px

Make sure to pick 20px.

lessons.title: Example: Top and bottom
lessons.interactiveContent:
Set the top margin to 20px and the left margin to 20px.

Make sure to pick margin, followed by 20px, and finally 20px.
lessons.hardModeContent:
Use shorthand so the buttons have 20px margin on the top and left, and 0 margin on the right and bottom.

Make sure to pick margin, followed by 20px, 0, 0, and finally 20px.

lessons.title: Question: Border-radius
lessons.interactiveContent:
What's the last value when using the border-radius shorthand?

The bottom-left cornerThe bottom-right cornerThe top-left corner

The bottom-left corner.
lessons.hardModeContent:
A rule uses border-radius: 4px 8px 12px 16px. Which corner gets 16px?

The bottom-left cornerThe top-left cornerThe top-right cornerThe bottom-right corner

Make sure to pick The bottom-left corner.

lessons.title: Question: Margins right
lessons.interactiveContent:
What's the order of values for the margin shorthand?

Top, right, bottom, leftTop, right, left, bottomTop-left, top-right, bottom-right, bottom-leftTop-right, top-left, bottom-left, bottom-right

Top, right, bottom, left.
lessons.hardModeContent:
You read a four-value margin shorthand from the first value to the last. Which side order does CSS use?

Top, right, bottom, leftTop, left, bottom, rightTop-left, top-right, bottom-right, bottom-leftLeft, top, right, bottom

Make sure to pick Top, right, bottom, left.

lessons.title: Example: Extreme value
lessons.interactiveContent:
Set the bottom-right corner to 150px, and the rest to 0.

Make sure to type 0 0 150px 0.
